name: subagent-statusline
description: Runs a subagentStatusLine-style command and draws its output as the subagent rows under the prompt

command.title: Command
command.description: Shell command run with native-322 subagentStatusLine JSON on stdin; prints one {"id","content"} JSON line per row. Managed hook policy takes precedence. Empty: leave legacy subagentStatusLine execution to Claude Code.
